source_count_method: Follow the production entrypoint import closure. Count local Lean files only. Strip nested block comments and line comments while retaining strings and character literals; count remaining nonempty lines. body_lines additionally removes module, import, and public-section lines; it is not a proof-only metric.
timing_method: Sequential single clean-output builds in isolated source directories using lake build and LEAN_NUM_THREADS=2, on the same shared host with the same pinned dependencies and reused dependency artifacts. Neither version has any local .lake/build artifacts initially. Single-import consumer times are three-run medians. An incomplete after build that exhausted disk space was excluded; the successful rerun started with empty local outputs. Downloads, audit/comparator runs, reports and packaging are excluded. Other host activity can affect wall time.
